title: Computational Simulation of Gold-Doped Water-Based Nanofluids
abstract: A molecular dynamics (MD) simulation study on the structural and dynamical properties of water molecules around gold nanoclusters (GNCs). Investigates size-dependent diffusion coefficients via Einstein relation, shear viscosity, and radial distribution functions (RDF). Based on TÜBİTAK 2209-A research calculations and presented as a poster at the 2024 Turkish Physical Society (TFD) Congress under advisor Assoc. Prof. Dr. Emine Mine Çapar. Published as a peer-reviewed research paper in Applied Nano (MDPI), Vol. 7, Issue 4, Art. 37 (DOI: 10.3390/applnano7040037).
